mapper.select:
select * from ( SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiNo, T2.ACCT_NAME acctName, T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO busiAcctNo, T1.VDATE vdate, t1.MDATE mdate, t1.TRADE_DATE settleDate, t1.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, (CASE WHEN t1.trade_status = #{TRADE_STATUS_03} THEN #{TRADE_FLOW_STATUS_03} ELSE #{TRADE_FLOW_STATUS_02} END) tradeStatus, T1.CCY ccy, T2.BANK_DEP bankDep from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 ON T2.ACCT_NO = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T2.CCY = T1.CCY
T1.IS_CANCEL = #{IS_CANCEL_N} AND T1.BUSI_TYPE = #{BUSI_TYPE} AND EXISTS (select * from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T3 INNER JOIN PTL_TRADE T4 ON T4.BUSI_NO = T3.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T5 ON T5.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID where T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
AND ( T5.PROD_MANAGER IN
null) or T5.PROD_MANAGER in (
#{item} )
)
AND t1.MDATE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{startMDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{endMDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{startsettleDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{endsettleDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND (T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO in
null) or T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO in (
#{item} )
AND T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{busiNo},'%'))
)
AND tradeStatus = #{tradeStatus}

SELECT S.BUSI_ACCT_NO busiAcctNo, S.Acct_Name acctName, S.ACCT_NO acctNo, P.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, P.CCY ccy, PTL.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, VAL.TDY_INTINCEXP theoryTradeAmt, VAL.TDY_INTINCEXP actualTradeAmt, CASE WHEN (SELECT count(0) from PTL_PORTFOLIO PTL1 where PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL1.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END isParentPortfolio, S.BANK_DEP bankDep FROM PTL_CAPACCT_INFO P INNER JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO S ON P.ACCT_NO = S.ACCT_NO AND P.CCY = S.CCY INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_VALUTION VAL ON VAL.PORTFOLIO_ID = P.PORTFOLIO_ID AND VAL.FINPROD_ID = P.ACCT_NO AND VAL.CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{mdate},'%Y-%m-%d')-1 INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD AD ON AD.PORTFOLIO_ID = P.PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FIN ON FIN.FINPROD_ID = AD.FINPROD_ID AND FIN.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE2_F16} INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PTL ON P.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID 1=1
AND ( S.BUSI_ACCT_NO IN
null) or S.BUSI_ACCT_NO in ( #{item} )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT *FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TOTAL WHERE TOTAL.FINPROD_ID = S.ACCT_NO AND TOTAL.MDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{mdate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND TOTAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE2_F21} AND TOTAL.BUSI_TYPE = #{BUSI_TYPE_PTL03} AND TOTAL.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} AND TOTAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} )

select #{busiAcctNo} busiAcctNo, #{acctName} acctName, #{acctNo} acctNo, VAL.CCY ccy, P.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, P.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, VAL.TDY_INTINCEXP theoryTradeAmt, VAL.TDY_INTINCEXP actualTradeAmt, 'N' isParentPortfolio from PTL_SEC_VALUTION VAL INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO P ON VAL.PORTFOLIO_ID = P.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE P.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND VAL.CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{mdate}, '%Y-%m-%d') - 1 AND VAL.FINPROD_ID = #{acctNo} AND VAL.CCY = #{ccy} and IFNULL(VAL.TDY_INTINCEXP,0) > 0

SELECT deal.trade_id busiNo, S.BUSI_ACCT_NO busiAcctNo, S.Acct_Name acctName, S.ACCT_NO acctNo, P.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, IFNULL(deal.ccy, P.CCY) ccy, PTL.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, VAL.TDY_INTINCEXP theoryTradeAmt, IFNULL(deal.trade_amt , 0) actualTradeAmt, CASE WHEN (SELECT count(0) from PTL_PORTFOLIO PTL1 where PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL1.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END isParentPortfolio, S.BANK_DEP bankDep FROM PTL_CAPACCT_INFO P INNER JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO S ON P.ACCT_NO = S.ACCT_NO AND P.CCY = S.CCY INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_VALUTION VAL ON VAL.PORTFOLIO_ID = P.PORTFOLIO_ID AND VAL.FINPROD_ID = P.ACCT_NO AND VAL.CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{mdate},'%Y-%m-%d')-1 INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD AD ON AD.PORTFOLIO_ID = P.PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FIN ON FIN.FINPROD_ID = AD.FINPROD_ID AND FIN.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE2_F16} INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PTL ON P.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID left join trd_Product_Deal deal on s.acct_no = deal.finprod_id and s.ccy = deal.ccy and deal.totle_trade_id = #{busiNo} 1=1
AND ( S.BUSI_ACCT_NO IN
null) or S.BUSI_ACCT_NO in ( #{item} )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT *FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TOTAL WHERE TOTAL.FINPROD_ID = S.ACCT_NO AND TOTAL.MDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{mdate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND TOTAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE2_F21} AND TOTAL.BUSI_TYPE = #{BUSI_TYPE_PTL03} AND TOTAL.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} AND TOTAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} )
